text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The newspaper's economy experts draw up and publish the list of the 100 biggest companies in Lithuania.
- The drop in price of milk-powder and casein on the world market knocked out Lithuanian milk processors.
- Thousands of people gathered for the opening ceremony of a monument to the founder of Vilnius, Great Duke Gediminas, in the Cathedral square of the Lithuanian capital on Sunday.
- A financially strong competitor, the Alliance of Lithuanian National Minorities (ALMN), is among the parties fighting for the votes of non-Lithuanians in the October parliamentary elections.
- The President of Ukraine Leonid Kuchma and his wife arrive for a two day official visit to Vilnius today. It is expected that the two men will sign an illegal immigrants readmission agreement.

- Five foreign companies, Fluor Daniel Inc., Preussag Anlagenbau, Lukoil, ARA Group and Omegon Petroleum Products Ltd, expressed their wish to buy shares in the planned Butinge oil terminal. The results of negotiations which started recently should become known before October 29.
- Lithuanian body building star Natalija Murnikoviene won a bronze medal in World professional body builders championship in Chicago on Saturday.
